intro.text: Welcome to the Hand Building Factory. First, the palm. Take it from the printer to the stand. Follow the yellow arrows, and grab parts with the trigger.

phase-palm.text: First, the palm. Take it from the printer to the stand.

screw-palm.text: Drive the four screws into the stand.

phase-motors.text: Now the five motors. Take each one from the conveyor to the back of the hand.

screw-motors.text: One screw each. Drive the motors into the back of the hand.

phase-thumb-base.text: Next, the thumb base. Printer to the side of the palm.

screw-thumb-base.text: One screw. Drive the thumb base into the palm.

phase-fingers.text: Now the four fingers. Printer to the top of the palm.

screw-fingers.text: One screw each. Drive the fingers into the palm.

phase-thumb-segments.text: Now the thumb segments. Printer to the thumb base.

screw-thumb-segments.text: One screw. Drive the segments into the thumb base.

phase-cover.text: Last, the cover. Printer to the back of the hand.

screw-cover.text: Two screws. Drive the cover into the back of the hand.

tool-on.text: Screwdriver ready. Touch its tip to a screw.

menu.text: Press A or X to open the menu.
